commands.name: add-dir
commands.description: Add a working directory for file access during the current session.

commands.name: advisor
commands.description: Enable or disable the advisor tool, which consults a second model for guidance at key moments during a task.

commands.name: agents
commands.description: Print a reminder to ask Claude to create or manage subagents, or to edit .claude/agents/ or ~/.claude/agents/ directly.

commands.name: artifact-capabilities
commands.description: Load the reference for the runtime capabilities a published artifact can use, such as calling your connectors or offering a file download, including which ones your account has.

commands.name: artifact-diagramming
commands.description: Load diagramming guidance for Claude to follow in artifacts: when a diagram helps, what to draw, and how to write inline SVG that stays legible in light and dark themes.

commands.name: artifacts
commands.description: List the artifacts you own or that are shared with you, then attach one to the session, open it in your browser, or copy its link.

commands.name: auto-mode-setup
commands.description: Draft autoMode.environment entries from your project and recent sessions, then review the draft and save it to your user settings.

commands.name: autocompact
commands.description: Set the auto-compact window: how full the context window gets before Claude Code compacts automatically.

commands.name: autofix-pr
commands.description: Spawn a cloud session that watches the current branch's PR and pushes fixes when CI fails or reviewers leave comments.

commands.name: background
commands.description: Detach the current session to run as a background agent and free this terminal.

commands.name: batch
commands.description: Orchestrate large-scale changes across a codebase in parallel.

commands.name: branch
commands.description: Create a branch of the current conversation at this point, so you can try a different direction without losing the conversation as it stands.

commands.name: btw
commands.description: Ask a side question about the current session without adding to the conversation.

commands.name: bug
commands.description: Report a bug or share your conversation.

commands.name: cd
commands.description: Move this session to a new working directory, keeping the conversation.

commands.name: chrome
commands.description: Configure Claude in Chrome settings

commands.name: claude-api
commands.description: Load Claude API and Managed Agents reference material for your project's language.

commands.name: claude-in-chrome
commands.description: Have Claude carry out a task in your browser, such as testing a page, filling a form, or reading console logs, through Claude in Chrome.

commands.name: clear
commands.description: Start a new conversation with empty context.

commands.name: code-review
commands.description: Review the current diff, or a PR number, branch, or path you pass, for correctness bugs.

commands.name: color
commands.description: Set the prompt bar color for the current session.

commands.name: compact
commands.description: Free up context by summarizing the conversation so far.

commands.name: config
commands.description: Open the Settings interface to adjust theme, model, output style, and other preferences.

commands.name: context
commands.description: Visualize current context usage as a colored grid.

commands.name: copy
commands.description: Copy the last assistant response to clipboard.

commands.name: cost
commands.description: Alias for /usage

commands.name: dataviz
commands.description: Design guidance for charts, graphs, and dashboards.

commands.name: debug
commands.description: Enable debug logging for the current session and troubleshoot issues by reading the session debug log.

commands.name: deep-research
commands.description: Fan out web searches on a question, fetch and cross-check sources, and synthesize a cited report

commands.name: design
commands.description: Draft UI mockups, screen flows, landing pages, or posters as artboards on one canvas, published as a Claude Design artifact, for example /design a settings screen for a mobile banking app.

commands.name: design-login
commands.description: Authorize design-system access for /design-sync with your claude.ai account.

commands.name: design-sync
commands.description: Convert your repo's React design system and upload it to Claude Design, so designs it produces use your real components.

commands.name: desktop
commands.description: Continue the current session in the Claude Code Desktop app.

commands.name: diff
commands.description: Review the changes in your working tree, including the edits Claude has made so far.

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Run a setup checkup that diagnoses installation, settings, extension, and CLAUDE.md problems and proposes fixes that Claude applies after you confirm.

commands.name: effort
commands.description: Set the effort level: low to xhigh, max, or auto; status prints it.

commands.name: exit
commands.description: Exit the CLI.

commands.name: export
commands.description: Export the current conversation as plain text.

commands.name: fast
commands.description: Toggle fast mode on or off.

commands.name: feedback
commands.description: Send product feedback about Claude Code.

commands.name: fewer-permission-prompts
commands.description: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts

commands.name: focus
commands.description: Toggle the focus view, which shows only your last prompt, a one-line tool-call summary with edit diffstats, and the final response.

commands.name: fork
commands.description: Copy the current conversation into a new background session and keep working here.

commands.name: goal
commands.description: Set a goal: Claude keeps working across turns until the condition is met or the goal clears for another reason.

commands.name: heapdump
commands.description: Write a JavaScript heap snapshot and a memory breakdown to ~/Desktop, or your home directory on Linux without a Desktop folder, for diagnosing high memory usage.

commands.name: help
commands.description: Show help and available commands

commands.name: hooks
commands.description: View hook configurations

commands.name: ide
commands.description: Manage IDE integrations and show status

commands.name: import

commands.name: init
commands.description: Initialize project with a CLAUDE.md guide.

commands.name: insights
commands.description: Generate an HTML report analyzing your recent sessions on this machine: which projects you work in, how you use Claude Code, where things go wrong, and features to try.

commands.description: Install the Claude GitHub App for a repository, with an optional step to set up GitHub Actions workflows and secrets.

commands.name: install-slack-app
commands.description: Install the Claude Slack app.

commands.name: keybindings
commands.description: Open your keyboard shortcuts file

commands.name: list-agents
commands.description: List the subagents, agent team teammates, and other Claude Code sessions Claude can message, with the name to use for each.

commands.name: login

commands.name: logout
commands.description: Sign out from your Anthropic account

commands.name: loop
commands.description: Run a prompt repeatedly while the session stays open.

commands.name: mcp
commands.description: Manage MCP server connections and OAuth authentication.

commands.name: memory
commands.description: Edit CLAUDE.md files, enable or disable auto memory, and view auto memory entries

commands.name: mobile
commands.description: Show QR code to download the Claude mobile app.

commands.name: model
commands.description: Switch the AI model and save it as your default for new sessions.

commands.name: output-style
commands.description: List output styles or switch to one, for example /output-style concise.

commands.name: passes
commands.description: Share a free week of Claude Code with friends.

commands.name: permissions
commands.description: Manage allow, ask, and deny rules for tool permissions.

commands.name: plan
commands.description: Enter plan mode directly from the prompt.

commands.name: plugin
commands.description: Manage Claude Code plugins.

commands.name: plugin-authoring
commands.description: Load the reference Claude works from to write a mod.

commands.name: powerup
commands.description: Discover Claude Code features through quick interactive lessons with animated demos

commands.name: pr-comments
commands.description: Removed in v2.1.91.

commands.name: privacy-settings
commands.description: View and update your privacy settings.

commands.name: radio
commands.description: Open Claude FM lo-fi radio in your browser.

commands.name: rate-limit-options
commands.description: Show ways to keep working when a claude.ai usage limit blocks a request: wait and continue automatically when the limit resets, add usage credits, or upgrade your plan.

commands.name: recap
commands.description: Generate a one-line summary of the current session on demand.

commands.name: release-notes
commands.description: View the changelog in an interactive version picker.

commands.name: reload-plugins
commands.description: Reload all active plugins to apply pending changes without restarting.

commands.name: reload-skills
commands.description: Re-scan skill and command directories so skills added or changed on disk during the session become available without restarting.

commands.name: remote-control
commands.description: Make this session available for Remote Control from claude.ai.

commands.name: remote-env
commands.description: Choose the default cloud environment for cloud sessions you start from the CLI

commands.name: rename
commands.description: Rename the current session and show the name on the prompt bar.

commands.name: restart
commands.description: Restart Claude Code and resume this session, which applies an installed update.

commands.name: resume
commands.description: Resume a conversation by ID or name, or open the session picker.

commands.name: rewind

commands.description: Launch and drive your project's app to see a change working, not only passing tests.

commands.name: sandbox
commands.description: Toggle sandbox mode.

commands.name: schedule
commands.description: Create, update, list, or run cloud scheduled tasks, formerly routines.

commands.name: scroll-speed
commands.description: Adjust mouse wheel scroll speed interactively.

commands.name: security-review
commands.description: Analyze the changes on your current branch for security vulnerabilities.

commands.name: setup-bedrock

commands.name: setup-vertex
commands.description: Configure Google Cloud's Agent Platform authentication, project, region, and model pins through an interactive wizard.

commands.name: simplify
commands.description: Review the changed code for cleanup opportunities and apply the fixes.

commands.name: skill-doctor
commands.description: Show what each of your skills costs in context and how often it gets used, so you can find skills to turn off.

commands.name: skills
commands.description: List available skills.

commands.name: slides

commands.name: stats
commands.description: Alias for /usage.

commands.name: statusline

commands.name: stickers

commands.description: Generate a team onboarding guide from your Claude Code usage history.

commands.name: teleport
commands.description: Pull a cloud session into this terminal.

commands.name: theme

commands.description: Removed.
